en.title: Letter Candles
en.description:
The cost of a box is the sum of the squares of the frequencies of each lowercase letter. Remove at most M candles and find the minimum achievable cost.

See below for this site's input format and constraints.
en.input: Three lines give N, M, and the string S in that order. |S|=N, and S contains only lowercase English letters. The source gives no numeric ranges; this site uses 1≤N≤1000000 and 0≤M≤N.
en.explanation: Removing one candle from the character with the currently highest frequency always gives the largest marginal gain; there are only 26 letter types, so the heap simulation runs at most min(M,N) times.
